kp/cusps/event-groups.yaml.binding: Evaluate only for the selected question and its named cusp. Missing or unstable lord or chart returns unknown. Store every supporting level with its actor.

kp/number-horary/249-divisions.yaml.bounds: inclusive start, exclusive end; wrap full turn to zero
kp/number-horary/249-divisions.yaml.source: kp-dutta-online, introduction to the stellar subdivisions and sign crossings

kp/number-horary/input.yaml.ascendant: Use the exact lower bound of the selected row; add the judgment-instant KP offset to obtain the tropical rising longitude.
kp/number-horary/input.yaml.binding: Bind chosen number to the corresponding ascendant arc and record the local question instant, city and KP ayanamsa. Evaluate the relevant cusps using the same method. An invalid number produces no chart.
kp/number-horary/input.yaml.planets: Use actual judgment-time longitudes; the synthetic ARMC changes only the numbered house frame.
kp/number-horary/input.yaml.remaining_cusps: At the judgment latitude and obliquity solve for ARMC for which the tropical eastern ascendant is the target. Compute Placidus cusps with that ARMC and subtract the same KP offset once. Check cusp 1 against the selected longitude. Leave unsolved or polar cusps unknown.
kp/number-horary/input.yaml.ruling_planets: Use the actual judgment ascendant for ruling planets.

kp/significators/bhava360.yaml.cusp: Use the cusp sub lord and its significations for the question’s house group. Require dasha and transit dates for a time window.

four_step.evidence: For each actor record its occupied house and all houses whose cusp it owns. Preserve duplicate actors by step.
four_step.node_agent: Record the node’s sign ruler as a separate representative with the node’s priority at that step; keep agent houses distinct from direct ownership.
four_step.primary: At steps 2 and 4 residence is primary. At steps 1 and 3 it is primary if the actor occupies its own star or no other graha occupies its stars. Owned houses are primary only for a primary residence actor and an empty house. Remaining links are secondary.
four_step.scope: Core four-step profile; conjunction/aspect extensions vary by school. Keep its testimony separate from the ranked-level cusp predicate.

kp/significators/bhava360.yaml.number_horary: Accept an integer 1–249, select its zodiac interval and apply the stated number-horary cusp method at the question place.
kp/significators/bhava360.yaml.ownership: Use the classical ruler of each cusp sign. A repeated sign may own several cusps; an intercepted sign may own none. Nodes occupy houses and can be star/sub lords; they own no signs.
kp/significators/bhava360.yaml.per_planet: Track the house occupied by the star lord, the planet’s own occupied house, the houses owned by the star lord and then by the planet. Retain levels and distinct evidence.
kp/significators/bhava360.yaml.ruling_context: Use the actual judgment instant and place, including for numbered horary. Count distinct roles per graha and retain any intersection with the selected event significators.
kp/significators/bhava360.yaml.ruling_planets: At the actual local question instant list weekday lord, Moon sign/star lords and ascendant sign/star lords. Retain overlaps with the question significators.
kp/significators/bhava360.yaml.weekday_boundary: Local sunrise to next sunrise. Use previous weekday before local sunrise; missing sunrise gives unknown.

kp/star-sub-lords/divisions.yaml.cusps: Compute all twelve Placidus cusps with a pinned KP ayanamsa. An unavailable cusp gives unknown for its dependent result.
kp/star-sub-lords/divisions.yaml.horary: Split the 243 star-sub arcs at the six additional sign boundaries to form 249 ordered intervals. Preserve half-open intersections.
kp/star-sub-lords/divisions.yaml.method: Each 800 arcminute nakshatra is divided in Vimshottari order beginning with its star lord. Each sub spans 800 × dasha years / 120 arcminutes. Sub-sub spans scale the same way beginning at the sub lord.
kp/star-sub-lords/divisions.yaml.precision: Use exact fractional offsets for finer divisions; never round a longitude up to select a row. The parent for sub-sub lookup retains its full width across a sign cut.
